content.text:
Classify this financial advisory firm as either "independent" or "big_firm".

BIG FIRMS include major wirehouses and large national firms like:
- Wells Fargo Advisors, Merrill Lynch, Edward Jones, Morgan Stanley, UBS
- Raymond James, LPL Financial, Ameriprise, Charles Schwab, Vanguard
- Northwestern Mutual, New York Life, MassMutual, Prudential
- Any major bank or insurance company offering financial services

INDEPENDENT FIRMS include:
- Small local advisory firms with personal names (Smith Financial, Johnson Wealth Management)
- Regional firms with geographic references (Bay Area Financial, Texas Wealth Advisors)
- Generic planning names (Retirement Planning Services, Wealth Strategies Group)
- Small RIA firms and independent practices

Firm name: "${firmName}"

Respond with only one word: either "independent" or "big_firm
